import cv2
import time
from ultralytics import YOLO
# Load OpenImages YOLOv8 model (600 classes)
model = YOLO("yolov8x-oiv7.pt")  # Make sure this file exists
device = "cpu"
# Open webcam
cap = cv2.VideoCapture(0)
# Set resolution (optional)
cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH, 640)
cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT, 480)
frame_width = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH))
frame_height = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))
# Video writer
fps = 20
fourcc = cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*"mp4v")
out = cv2.VideoWriter("max_objects_cpu.mp4", fourcc, fps, (frame_width, frame_height))
prev_time = 0
print("Detecting ~600 object classes on CPU...")
print("Press 'q' to quit")
while True:
    ret, frame = cap.read()
    if not ret:
        break
    frame = cv2.resize(frame, (640, 480))
    results = model(frame, device=device, conf=0.25)
    annotated = results[0].plot()
    # FPS counter
    current_time = time.time()
    fps_display = 1 / (current_time - prev_time) if prev_time else 0
    prev_time = current_time
    cv2.putText(annotated, f"FPS: {int(fps_display)}",
                (20, 40), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
                1, (0, 255, 0), 2)
    out.write(annotated)
    cv2.imshow("Max Objects Detection (600 classes)", annotated)
    if cv2.waitKey(1) & 0xFF == ord('q'):
        break
cap.release()
out.release()
cv2.destroyAllWindows()
